name: lumnd/platophp
description: A lightweight HTTP, WebSocket/TCP, and multiprocess CLI service framework for PHP 8

suggest.smarty/smarty: ^5.5, the engine behind plato\view\smarty, the default template driver. Nothing else in the framework touches it, and plato\view\native renders plain PHP templates with no package at all -- so this is only needed by an application that chose Smarty and renders templates
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: MySQL and MariaDB connections (plato\database\driver\mysql). Without it the database layer has no SQL engine to talk to
suggest.ext-redis: Redis cache store, the redis and stream queue drivers, and plato\lock -- which has no other backend
suggest.ext-memcached: Memcached cache store. The older ext-memcache is not supported
suggest.ext-curl: plato\http\client, and the ClickHouse connection, which speaks HTTP
suggest.ext-pcntl: plato\pool worker supervisor and the signal handling of queue:work; a resident CLI process wants both this and ext-posix
suggest.ext-posix: Process identity for plato\pool and plato\runtime's fork detection
suggest.ext-simplexml: application/xml request bodies (plato\http\req). Its absence is reported when an XML body is first parsed; malformed XML is dropped
suggest.ext-readline: Line editing in cli::input(); without it the prompt still works, it is just dumber
suggest.ext-igbinary: The `igbinary` value of the redis `serializer` setting; the driver falls back to JSON when it is missing
suggest.lumnd/plato-workerman: Resident server adapter, websocket and tcp. This package ships no event loop: src/server holds the driver contract and the message to ct/ac dispatcher, the loop comes from an adapter
suggest.psr/log: ^3.0, for plato\psr\logger -- hands plato\log to a library that asks for a PSR-3 logger
suggest.psr/simple-cache: ^3.0, for plato\psr\cache -- hands plato\cache to a library that asks for a PSR-16 cache
